title: Extract priority weights to shared constant
description:
MEDIUM #5 from code review.

Priority-to-weight mapping duplicated in multiple files:
- CORE=1.0, IMPORTANT=0.8, SUPPLEMENTARY=0.5

Create shared constant:
```typescript
// shared/constants/priority-weights.ts
export const PRIORITY_WEIGHTS = {
  CORE: 1.0,
  IMPORTANT: 0.8,
  SUPPLEMENTARY: 0.5,
} as const;

export function getPriorityWeight(priority: DocumentPriorityLevel | null): number
```

Update all usages to import from shared constant.

title: REF: Pipeline Stages 1-7
description:
## Course Generation Pipeline

| Stage | Name | Input | Output |
|-------|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | Document Upload | Files (PDF, DOCX) | file_catalog |
| 2 | Document Processing | file_catalog | Markdown chunks |
| 3 | Classification | Chunks | document_priorities |
| 4 | Budget Allocation | Priorities | RAG plan |
| 5 | Structure Generation | RAG | sections, lessons (specs) |
| 6 | Lesson Content | Specs | lesson_content (full text) |
| 7 | Enrichments | Content | lesson_enrichments (media) |

## Key Components
- **Orchestrator**: `src/orchestrator/` — FSM, queue management
- **BullMQ Workers**: `src/workers/` — parallel processing
- **Judge System**: `stage6/judge/` — LLM quality validation
- **RAG**: Qdrant + Jina embeddings

## Code Location
`packages/course-gen-platform/src/stages/stageN-*/`

title: REF: Business Entities
description:
## Core Entities

| Entity | Description | Table |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| Organization | Company/team, owns courses | `organizations` |
| User | User, belongs to org | `users` |
| Course | Course with sections→lessons | `courses` |
| Section | Course section | `sections` |
| Lesson | Lesson with content | `lessons`, `lesson_content` |
| Enrichment | Media enrichment | `lesson_enrichments` |

## Hierarchy
```
Organization
  └── Course
        └── Section (1..n)
              └── Lesson (1..n)
                    └── Enrichment (0..n): video, audio, quiz, presentation
```
